TEXT_DESCRIPTION_1: **Full-stack developer** from Ensenada, Mexico. I build **web and mobile apps**, from the interface to the systems behind it.

EXPERIENCE.title: Shopify Developer
EXPERIENCE.description: Building Shopify storefronts with Liquid and JavaScript. I work with designers and developers on responsive pages that make products easier to browse and buy.

EXPERIENCE.title: Freelance Full-Stack Developer
EXPERIENCE.description: Building a booking website for a service business with Next.js, TypeScript and Strapi. I deliver responsive pages, CMS-managed listings and filters so the client can update content without code.

EXPERIENCE.title: Application Developer Intern
EXPERIENCE.description: Shipped React features for a medical AI assistant used across several brands. I also built automated build checks and a Playwright reporting pipeline on AWS.

EXPERIENCE.title: Automated Testing Trainee
EXPERIENCE.description: Built Java UI and API test suites in an enterprise-focused training program. Used Selenium, RestAssured and TestNG with reusable utilities and the Page Object Model.

EXPERIENCE.title: Software Developer & Research Assistant
EXPERIENCE.description: Designed the app architecture and set up its Supabase backend with PostgreSQL and row-level security. Built 20+ React Native screens and a questionnaire engine that accepts new screening instruments through configuration.

PROJECTS.title: Stilo
PROJECTS.description: I led development of an app that builds outfits from your own clothes. I designed its AI recommendation pipeline and drag-and-drop canvas. In a 10-person study, AI-assisted outfit creation took 83.4% fewer UI interactions than the manual flow.
PROJECTS.context: Co-Author & Lead Developer • Paper accepted at MexIHC 2026
contributions: Designed the recommendation pipeline that interprets prompts, finds matching clothes, and assembles outfits.
Built the multiplatform app with a custom drag-and-drop outfit canvas.
Provisioned cloud infrastructure on Azure using Terraform.

PROJECTS.title: NASA Explorer
PROJECTS.description: Ask questions about NASA space-biology research and get answers backed by published sources. I built the NestJS chat and RAG backend, a Python ingestion pipeline, and parts of the interactive React knowledge graph.
PROJECTS.context: Team of 6 • 1st Place — NASA Space Apps Challenge 2025
contributions: Built the backend — chat, history, users, and RAG orchestration with Vertex AI.
Developed frontend features: interactive knowledge graph, article favorites, and chat integration.

PROJECTS.title: Awita
PROJECTS.description: I built this system to help my family avoid running out of water. An Arduino checks the tank every minute, AWS handles the readings, and a React dashboard shows the level and sends alerts. It has run at home for over a year.
contributions: Designed the full system — Arduino firmware, a Go Lambda for sensor ingestion, the NestJS API, and the React dashboard.
Trained an LSTM to forecast when the tank would empty, measured it against the latency it added, and switched it off.

OTHER_PROJECTS.title: Havi
OTHER_PROJECTS.description: At a two-day banking hackathon, I built the 8-screen mobile app for a proactive banking copilot. Its typed data layer combines pipeline alerts with account data and falls back to demo data when the backend is unavailable.

OTHER_PROJECTS.title: Espyntar
OTHER_PROJECTS.description: A C++ drawing game for up to eight players. Custom TCP messages keep the canvas, guesses and scores in sync across clients.

OTHER_PROJECTS.title: 16-BDH
OTHER_PROJECTS.description: A three-level RPG that teaches the Battle of Puebla through play. Built with a custom C and Raylib engine and released for desktop and web.

OTHER_PROJECTS.title: Espify
OTHER_PROJECTS.description: A shared listening room in the terminal. Its Java socket server streams audio, manages the queue and keeps playback in sync for everyone in the room.

TEXT_MORE_ABOUT_1: I discovered my passion for programming at 16 through Arduino projects, which sparked my interest in software development. This early experience taught me the importance of problem-solving and creative thinking in technology.
TEXT_MORE_ABOUT_2: When I'm not coding, I enjoy gaming, spending time with friends and family, reading, and playing guitar. I'm always eager to learn and chat about new tech.
